_doc: caves_east: Sapphire's terraces as heights (16 per stair tile): main floor (rows 20-24) 32 above the exit level (rows 25-40, the lower river); the elevation-4 platform/entrance/bridge 48; the right ledge (24-28,13-15) and the upper-left ledge 64; the top level around the upper pool 96 (heights in whole 16-unit levels: a ladder's MapChangeCore names the level). The log bridge (19-21,18-19) is a walk-under bridge over the upper river; the two waterfalls are Black 2 waterfalls (upper pool 88 -> middle pool 24, upper river 24 -> lower river -8). Origin (0,11): the cave is split over two chunks at Sapphire row 21 (a chunk file must stay under 110,600 bytes).
